title: XR session handoff across devices
bottleneck: Starting a task in VR, continuing on a phone, and finishing on a laptop should be seamless, but XR apps are siloed: spatial state, anchors, and interaction context don't transfer. No standard represents 'where I was standing and what I was holding' across devices. The XR device is an island.
why_it_blocks: Computing is increasingly multi-device; XR that can't hand off becomes a dead end for workflows. Continuity is what turns a gadget into a platform.
current_state: Cloud-synced app state exists in limited forms, but spatial-context handoff standards and cross-device XR continuity frameworks don't exist. Without shared representations of spatial state, every device starts from zero and multi-device workflows stay manual. No standard represents spatial context like position, gaze, and held objects, so continuity across devices stays a manual chore.
